reasons.why: The profile has no dominant data type: 100% of items and chars are class 'other', with 0 code and 0 binary. Prose is not labelled either, and there are 0 mentions, 0 commits and 0 pull requests. Items are short (p50 425 chars, p99 1476), so the documents strategy's long passages do not fit. Every built-in strategy measured the same recall_all@5 of 0.1163 (n 301, se 0.0185) as the default, so none shows a gain. I keep the code strategy, which sets nothing and leaves the default graph.

Keep the release defaults for the query keys. The body-heavy candidate (bm25_body 4.0) scored 0.1096, 0.0067 below the default. The name-light candidate (bm25_name 2.0, bm25_path 1.0) scored 0.113, 0.0033 below the default. Both differences are well under two standard errors (about 0.037), so they are noise, and no candidate beats the default. The build keys and semantic mode stay unchanged. An entities step is not justified. The tune figures do not support it, it costs money, and phone numbers in 90 items make a model sink a label risk. No model step is wanted.
